headline: Weathered Expanse Rages as Coastal Flanks Shake and Center Calms
war_summary: Marban Hollow and Olavis Wake have sharply cooled over the past two hours, registering no further base turnovers after earlier frantic clashes. Instead, the sharpest action remains locked in Weathered Expanse, which recorded three strategic changes in two hours around Spirit Watch and Frostmarch while devouring more than twenty-six hundred casualties. Fresh territorial shifts have also erupted along the flanks. Farranac Coast broke its deadlock with two base actions as Colonials secured Transient Valley, while Nevish Line logged a pair of rapid exchanges over Tomb Father, leaving one position in neutral ruins. In Kuura Strand, combat intensity accelerated abruptly, claiming nearly two thousand casualties within two hours across a fractured front divided three bases to two. By contrast, massive bloodletting in Callahan’s Passage and Dead Lands produced no alterations in line ownership, and previous friction points across Linn of Mercy and Pari Peak settled into relative silence.
